title: The bounded first-delivery candidates follow creation order rather than priority
outcome: The bounded first-delivery candidates follow creation order rather than priority
acceptance: a test asserts that a newly added higher-priority ready item appears among the bounded first-delivery candidates ahead of older lower-priority ones, and that the first delivery plus the named continuation still reaches every ready item exactly once

completion.summary: Compact next, peek, and ls --ready rank by priority then work_id; continuation and stale restart stay exact-once.
